name: Soul of the Fighter
body:
Associated Skills: Climb, Intimidate, Survival, Swim

Associated Veils: Armlets of the Shaitan, Eyes of the Hawkguard, Greaves of Skirmishing, Impulse Earrings, Pursuer’s Cuffs, Shaitan’s Earthen Armor, Tauric Brace, Vambraces of Holy Scripture

Weapon Mastery (Ex)

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the fighter imbues you with incredible martial ability. When you forge this soul, select a fighter weapon group.

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMD against disarm and sunder attacks while wielding a weapon from the chosen weapon group, and against saving throws that would affect that weapon (such as grease, or heat metal). A veil that creates your wielded weapon is considered to be the weapon for the purposes of this ability. This bonus increases by 1 at 5th level, and every 4 levels thereafter.

Armor Training (Ex)

At 1st level, tapping into the fighter’s soul has made you more adept at maneuvering and fighting in armor. You reduce the armor check penalty of your worn armor by 1 (minimum 0), increase the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by your armor by 1, and you can move at your normal speed while wearing medium and heavy armor.

At 5th level, and every six levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by +1 each time, to a maximum –4 reduction of the armor check penalty and a +4 increase of the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed.

Advanced Armor Training

Beginning at 5th level, instead of increasing the benefits provided by armor training (reducing your armor’s check penalty by 1 and increasing its maximum Dexterity bonus by 1), you can choose an advanced armor training option.

You treat your soulforge level as your fighter level for this ability. You can replace the increases at 11th and 17th level with advanced armor training options as well.

Weapon Training (Ex)

At 3rd level, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls when using a weapon from your chosen weapon group with your weapon mastery ability. At 7th level, and every 6 levels thereafter, you can choose an additional weapon group with your weapon mastery ability, and the bonuses to attack and damage granted to your previously selected weapon groups are increased by +1 each.

Advanced Weapon Training: Beginning at 7th level, instead of selecting an additional fighter weapon group, you can choose an advanced weapon training option for one fighter weapon group you have previously selected with the weapon training class feature. You still gain the increase to attack and damage rolls for your previously selected weapon groups. You can replace an additional weapon group selection with an advanced weapon training option at 13th and 18th level as well.
